text:
Which statement about the manufacture of ethene from larger alkane molecules is correct?
A
A low temperature is required.
B
The process is called cracking.
C
The process requires an excess of oxygen.
D
Water is also a product.

options.label: C
options.text: The process requires an excess of oxygen.
